description: Matt Lehman is a candidate for Kentucky's 4th Congressional District. He lives in Newport with his wife Adriana and 3 kids and is a life sciences executive and entrepreneur who gets things done. Most recently, he was co-founder and CEO of Louisville-based Koligo Therapeutics to bring opioid-free treatment to pancreatitis patients.
